approved_decision.rule: Resolve each locked slot's concept directly from the approved semantic blueprint, then generate 2 candidate G-ID forms per slot using semantic-first, G-ID-first, Phonotactic Profile V2 and collision-review contracts. Generation produces review options only.

governance_decisions.decision: Use NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as default lane; do not infer productive morphology from -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or prior lexical families.

Each option exposes slot ID, blueprint concept reference, G-ID sequence, IPA, governed romanization, phonotactic result, exact-collision result, near-collision result and morphology-false-friend result.
Reject exact collisions against 33 recovered forms and all 100 authored registry entries through Wave 02; near collisions require explicit review.
This gate resolves no HOLD seed and creates no semantic authority beyond the already approved blueprint slots.
After generation prepare a separate Wave 03 human selection gate; generated options receive no registry status, HNK3000 credit, FROZEN authority, curriculum binding or runtime use.
